sources.entry: Bing Translator - Microsoft’s multi-platform web translation. #free

summary.name: Bing Translator
summary.one_liner: Microsoft's web translator for quickly translating words and phrases between English and over 100 languages.
use_cases: translate single words or short phrases
quick English to foreign language lookup
check how to say a phrase in another language
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Bing Translator, a web tool for quickly translating words and phrases between English and over 100 languages. It has a language swap control and a text box that accepts up to 1000 characters per translation. A section titled "Other ways to say" shows auto-generated example phrases such as Hello, Thank you, Good morning, and How are you?, with a note that results may not be exact or error-free. The page text also shows an error state indicating a translation limit was exceeded.
notable: Translates between English and over 100 languages
Accepts up to 1000 characters per translation
Auto-generated example phrases with a regenerate option
caveats: Translation usage limits apply; the page shows an error when the allowed translation amount is exceeded and asks to try later
Auto-generated examples may not be exact or error-free
